umbrella.title: Noun
umbrella.def: A portable folding canopy used to keep you dry from the rain.
umbrella.example: The cheerful yellow umbrella kept the brother and sister completely dry in the rain.
umbrella.phrase: Context: "The cheerful yellow umbrella kept the brother and sister completely dry in the rain."
umbrella.imgQuery: a bright yellow umbrella opened against gentle raindrops

unlock.title: Verb
unlock.def: To open a lock on a door or box using a key.
unlock.exampleEasy: Use the key to unlock the door.
unlock.example: The teacher used a shiny silver key to unlock the classroom door each morning.
unlock.phrase: Context: "The teacher used a shiny silver key to unlock the classroom door each morning."
unlock.imgQuery: a key unlocking a golden padlock on a wooden door
